title: Keep the incorporated load and rank-dependent precision repairs
statement: Whole-stack operator error requires per-column tolerance sigma/sqrt(capacity); correlated errors do not average away. Refresh old columns at power-of-two capacity changes and requery temporary load direction after each enrichment,earning Q<=k(T+4R) under the stated schedule. Price delta^-p gives O_p(k sigma^-p[(R+1)^(1+p/2)+T(R+1)^(p/2)]),not just call count. Omitting a tiny load component keeps its ORIGINALb residual and reduces the enrichment margin by ||b_miss||/||x||. The preparation-aware cutoff beta<=min(1/2,tau/[16(M_A+sigma)]) yields source-stated g=3tau/4 with sigma=tau/16. Finite implementation must enclose orthogonality,preparation,small-solve/norm and accumulated arithmetic errors; the supplied finite-arithmetic specification and double-precision diagnostics are not completed outward rounding or a universal bit-complexity theorem.

Storage O(knR), full-vector projections/output and reduced dense solves/QR paid. Squared Hermitian primitives use two original actions with propagated errors/preparation paid.
